title: A Day in the City
objective: After this level you can describe daily life in the city of Rome, from apartment blocks to the forum.
summary: Perhaps a million people crowded into Rome. Most rented rooms in risky apartment blocks; the rich lived in houses built around an atrium.

cards.headline: A million people, one city, and hardly anyone had a kitchen or a bath at home.
Apartment life
cards.body: By the time of Augustus, Rome had perhaps around 1 million inhabitants. Most lived in insulae, crowded apartment blocks several stories high, usually without running water or private baths. The upper floors were the cheapest, and fire and collapse were constant dangers.

cards.headline: Houses and the Forum
cards.body: Wealthy Romans lived in a domus, a private house built around an open hall called the atrium. Public life centered on the Forum, with its temples, law courts, markets and platforms for speeches.

cards.fact: Augustus gave Rome its first fire brigade.
cards.context: He created the vigiles, freedmen who fought fires and patrolled at night, and he limited new buildings to about 20 meters high.

cards.headline: The city: explored
learned: Rome had perhaps a million people
The rich lived in a domus
The Forum was the center of public life

questions.prompt: Where did most people in the city of Rome live?

options.label: In private houses with an atrium
In army camps outside the walls
options.rationale: Most were civilians in the city.

options.label: In farmhouses beyond the Tiber
options.rationale: Most lived in the city itself.

questions.explanation: Most Romans rented space in insulae, apartment blocks several stories high.

questions.prompt: Why were the upper floors of an insula the cheapest?

options.label: They had the best views of the Forum
Only enslaved people could live there
The Senate paid part of the rent for them
They were the hardest to escape in a fire

questions.explanation: Upper floors were the most dangerous in a fire or collapse, and the least convenient, so they cost least.

questions.prompt: From Level 3: what was the Forum valley before it was drained?
questions.explanation: The Forum valley was marshy until it was drained, helped by the Cloaca Maxima.
